title: [Master]-Act Consumption Qty field in Component of a Firm Planned Order has amounts that point to a Released Production Order that has the same Document No if the component is the same
summary: The Act. Consumption Qty shown for components of a firm planned production order no longer includes amounts from a released production order with the same document number and the same component. The fix is in the Prod. Order Components and Prod. Order Comp. Line List pages.
key_points: Consumption quantity for firm planned order components wrongly pointed to a released order with the same Document No.
Fix applied to the Prod. Order Components and Prod. Order Comp. Line List pages in the W1 and IT layers
